_doc: V4 Rocket Launcher raids (InvasionManager.spawnLauncherRaid): from fromWave, each wave rolls chance (+chancePerWave, capped) for a mobile launcher to roll out of a rift part-way through the wave, escorted by Mecha guards that stay close and only fight minions near it. It parks within rangeTiles of a random establishment (never the citadel), locks on for aimSeconds (red reticle on the target), then fires a rocket that lands flightMs later as a direct hit for damageMultiplier × its scaled damage (force fields and walls still soak it). Reloads for reloadSeconds and picks a new target each salvo. Kill it, or break its line by smashing it before the lock finishes.
